Skip the whole Reel if the slide number is unreadable

Choose one mode. Each time is saved separately, from 0 to 10 seconds, default 3 seconds for both. 0 means advance immediately after safe screen checks, not disabled.\nEach-photo mode waits the same time on the last photo, then opens the next Reel. If the slide number is unreadable, the optional fallback uses the whole-Reel delay; otherwise it waits.\nComments, menus, ambiguous screens and video items in mixed posts wait. Unconfirmed photo movement causes a safety stop. Turning off auto-advance stops all modes.
